This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Saber]] served as the '''personal aide''' of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]]. She joined her Lord when he went to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to rendezvous with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]]. She introduced Gaalan to the Nightsister leader [[Dresdema]], but was immediately afterward thrust into [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|battle]] with them after the Nightsisters perceived Gaalan's being male as an act of treachery. She incapacitated Dresdema with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] while her Sith comrades defeated the remaining witches and their pet [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. She later remained planetside with Gaalan while the rest of the Sith team brought the Nightsisters back to their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]] of [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] revealed themselves to the Sith on Dathomir, this female Saber joined Lord Gaalan in his [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|duel]] with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. During the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], she redirected her efforts toward Skywalker's son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and was later [[Sai tok/Legends|sliced in half]] by the young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] lightsaber.
